description: This file is the main bootstrap or entry-point script for initializing the OpenCart framework. It sets up core components such as autoloaders, registry, config, error and exception handling, event system, loaders, request and response handling, database, session, cache, template, language, URL, document, and routing logic. It orchestrates the startup process of the application by configuring and executing the initial request handling cycle.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Autoloader
classes.description: Handles dynamic class loading based on namespace and directory mappings.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Registry
classes.description: Acts as a registry container storing references to core services and components.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Config
classes.description: Manages application configuration settings and paths.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Log
classes.description: Provides logging functionality for errors and application events.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Event
classes.description: Implements an event system for triggering and registering event listeners.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Factory
classes.description: Provides factory methods for creating various core objects.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Loader
classes.description: Handles dynamic loading of models, libraries, and other components.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Request
classes.description: Represents the HTTP request object with GET, POST, COOKIE, and SERVER data.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Response
classes.description: Handles HTTP response output, headers, and compression.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\DB
classes.description: Database abstraction layer for connecting and executing queries.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Session
classes.description: Manages session start, data, and cookie handling.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Cache
classes.description: Provides caching mechanisms for performance optimization.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Template
classes.description: Manages template rendering and path management.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Document
classes.description: Represents the document object used for setting page titles, scripts, styles etc.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Action
classes.description: Represents an executable action, used for routing and controller execution.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a class or namespace with the autoloader.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a service or component instance into the registry.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a language file, model, or other component.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a route or action object.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for an action.
